step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage fully-differential op-amp with CMFB through output buffer
step1_figure.description: Figure 26.43 shows a fully-differential two-stage op-amp where common-mode feedback (CMFB) is applied solely to the output buffer stage using triode-operating MOSFETs driven by a CMFB differential amplifier, connected in the closed-loop feedback network shown in Figures 26.45 and 26.47.

open_loop_gain.description: DC open-loop differential voltage gain of the two-stage op-amp

equation.explanation: Product of the first-stage cascode diff-amp gain and the second-stage common-source output stage gain.
equation.assumptions: Diff-pair and output buffer operate in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_D ≈ 20 uA, V_ov ≈ 100 mV, g_m = 2*I_D/V_ov ≈ 400 uA/V. Output resistance r_o = 1/(lambda*I_D) = 1/(0.1*20u) = 500 kΩ. Cascoded first stage gives A_v1 ≈ 40-50 V/V, second stage A_v2 ≈ 8-10 V/V. Total open-loop gain A_OL ≈ 300 - 500 V/V (~50 - 54 dB). Fig. 26.44b shows peak gain ~400 V/V (52 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard two-stage design with moderate nanometer channel-length modulation yields open-loop gain in the hundreds (approx 400 V/V or 52 dB).

equation.explanation: Unity-gain frequency set by the input stage transconductance g_m and compensation capacitor C_c.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole compensation with Miller capacitor Cc = 25 fF.

sky130_expected.calculation: g_m = sqrt(2 * mu_n * C_ox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) ≈ 328 uA/V. With C_c = 25 fF: f_un = 328e-6 / (2 * pi * 25e-15) ≈ 2.09 GHz. Accounting for parasitic capacitances and loading, typical f_un is around 1.5 - 2.5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small 25 fF Miller capacitance and high-speed nanometer devices provide unity-gain frequency in the low-GHz range.

supply_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD supply including bias circuit

equation.explanation: Sum of currents in bias circuit (SUB_1), first-stage diff-amp, two output branches, and the CMFB differential amplifier.
equation.assumptions: All branches biased with VDD=1.8V under nominal quiescent conditions.

sky130_expected.calculation: Op-amp alone draws ~200 uA (diff pair: 40 uA, CMFB: ~40 uA, output buffers: 2x ~60 uA = 120 uA). Bias circuit draws ~50 uA. Total I_DD ≈ 250 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker explicitly quotes approximately 250 uA total current and 200 uA for the op-amp alone.

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage VDD (1.8V) and total supply current I_DD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct product of nominal VDD (1.8 V) and expected total supply current (~250 uA).

output_cm_voltage.description: Common-mode voltage of the balanced differential outputs

equation.explanation: CMFB loop forces the average of the two differential outputs to equal the common-mode reference V_CM.
equation.assumptions: CMFB loop operating with adequate loop gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Reference voltage V_CM is 500 mV (0.5 V). With high CMFB loop gain, V_CM_out settles to within millivolts of 0.5 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: CMFB differential pair compares averaged output voltage (via 20k resistors) against V_CM=0.5V and drives the triode pull-down network.

settling_time.description: 1% settling time in response to an input differential step

equation.explanation: Time required for the differential output step to settle within 1% of its final value.
equation.assumptions: Step response in the inverting gain-of-1 configuration with Cc=25 fF and CL=250 fF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Text states settling times are approximately 1-2 ns for both small- and large-signal step responses.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High GBW (~2 GHz) and fast slew rate allow sub-2 ns settling under moderate capacitive load (250 fF).

closed_loop_diff_gain.description: Closed-loop differential voltage gain in resistive feedback topology

equation.explanation: Inverting differential closed-loop gain established by feedback network resistors.
equation.assumptions: Open loop gain >> 1; balanced feedback network with R_in = 20k and R_f = 20k.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matched feedback and input resistors (R1=R2=R3=R4=20k) yield unity closed-loop differential gain.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice simulation testbench measuring operating point, supply current, power, DC common-mode balance, AC closed-loop and open-loop response, and transient settling time for the Fig. 26.43 op-amp.
